# Magento Version History: Complete Timeline from 2007 to 2026  
\[Updated: March 30, 2026]  
Magento launched as a beta in August 2007. Almost 19 years later, version 2.4.9 enters beta with PHP 8.5 support and a complete framework overhaul.  
This timeline covers every major Magento release, from the first osCommerce fork to Adobe's $1.68 billion acquisition to the current 2.4.x LTS line.
### Key Takeaways  
- Magento launched August 31, 2007 as a beta by Roy Rubin and Yoav Kutner
- Adobe acquired Magento in 2018 for $1.68 billion
- Magento 1 reached end of life June 30, 2020
- Magento 2.4.8 (current stable) released April 8, 2025 with PHP 8.4 and 497 fixes
- Magento 2.4.9-beta1 launched March 10, 2026 with PHP 8.5, HugeRTE, and Symfony Cache
## Version Support Timeline  
Each version receives 3 years of support from its GA date. Stores on 2.4.6 must upgrade before August 2026.

- Two games are free on the Epic Games Store between Thursday 6 August and Thursday 13 August 2026: Beacon Pines, a $19.99 illustrated mystery, and We Were Here Together, a $12.99 two-player co-op puzzle game. Both are Windows PC downloads through the Epic launcher, and both are claims rather than rentals — nothing expires out of your library afterwards.
- Caravan SandWitch is already confirmed as the next one, free from 13 to 20 August 2026. Epic publishes the following week’s giveaway in advance, which is why this one can be named before it goes live.
- Everything given away in July 2026 is gone. Six weekly windows ran between 25 June and 6 August — the last of them, OTXO and Sol Cesto, closed at 11 a.m. ET on 6 August. Epic giveaways do not come back later in the month, so a missed window is missed for good.
- Only one of the two current games works on your own. We Were Here Together cannot be played solo — it needs a second person who also owns it, which is the strongest argument for claiming it during a week when it costs both of you nothing.
**Two games are free on the Epic Games Store until 13 August 2026, and the one after them is already named.** Between **Thursday 6 August and Thursday 13 August 2026**, Epic is giving away **Beacon Pines** and **We Were Here Together**. From **13 to 20 August** it is **Caravan SandWitch**. Everything Epic gave away in July has already closed.  
These are **Windows PC** downloads claimed through the Epic Games Store launcher — there is no console version of the giveaway, though all three games sell separately on consoles as well. Checked on 6 August 2026.
## Which games are free on the Epic Games Store in August 2026?

**Beacon Pines** is a 2022 adventure from the studio Hiding Spot, published by Fellow Traveller. You play both a boy called Luka and the reader of the book he lives inside, collecting charm words that get slotted into blanks at turning points to send the story down a different branch. Epic rates it 12+ for mild swearing and lists it as single player.  
**We Were Here Together** is the third entry in a co-op series by the Dutch studio Total Mayhem Games, released in October 2019 after We Were Here in 2017 and We Were Here Too in 2018. Two Antarctic researchers answer a distress call, cross the frozen wastes, and end up separated inside a medieval castle with a walkie-talkie each and, as the store puts it, nothing but their wits. It supports cross-platform play, so your partner does not have to be on the Epic version — but they do have to own it somewhere.
